title: Cultural Access and Resilience
gallery_text:
I aim to use records of NYC’s cultural infrastructure, operating data, demograhpic conditions to explor how different funding decisions could have sustained public opportunities from 2020 to 2025.

Using 2020–2025 keeps the analysis close to documented conditions and allows the simulation to be compared with observed events, budgets, disruptions, facility closures, and program records. A later period such as 2027–2031 could be added as a separate prospective scenario.
